target: Import allowlisted, human-approved conversation decision capsules plus a marked manual fallback as non-authoritative planner proposals and visible reconciliation input.
invariants: Risk lane is L3 because private conversation provenance and authority interpretation are introduced.
TP-DMX-PCP-GITHUB-REFRESH-004 must be accepted before activation.
There is no assumed API for reading a user's existing ChatGPT history from repository runtime.
OpenAI Conversations API identifiers apply only to conversations created in the API project and are not treated as ChatGPT-history identifiers.
Initial supported inputs are approved decision capsule files and manual fallback; unsupported direct thread locators fail closed.
A proposal always has authority NONE and cannot approve, commit, merge, accept, or activate anything.
Raw transcripts are not persisted by default.
Conversation routes run only on the structurally loopback-only service inherited from TP-DMX-PCP-GITHUB-REFRESH-004; this packet cannot widen its bind.

execution.stacked_because: Final release packet; consumes the accepted portfolio and loopback service contracts.

commit.message: feat(planner): add governed conversation decision proposals

pr.title: feat(planner): add governed conversation decision proposals
pr.body: L3 import of allowlisted, human-approved decision capsules with marked manual fallback. Proposals are non-authoritative, raw transcripts are not retained, conflicts remain visible, and no approval or repository write endpoint exists.

steps.task: Define strict decision capsule and proposal schemas plus an explicit source allowlist.
requirements: Decision capsule requires capsule_id, source_kind, canonical_thread_locator, normalized_text, target repository and scope, human approver identity, approved_at, source_content_sha256, and capsule_sha256.
Allowed source kinds are APPROVED_CAPSULE and MANUAL_FALLBACK; every other kind is rejected.
Manual fallback requires a reason and is visibly marked manual.
Proposal schema requires authority NONE, surface_class PROJECTION, is_proof false, import timestamp, and source provenance.
validation: Non-allowlisted locator, absent approver, mismatched hash, raw transcript field, and unsupported source kind fail validation.
Configuration stores locators and hashes, never conversation credentials or transcript bodies.

steps.task: Implement deterministic capsule verification, proposal creation, and portfolio reconciliation.
requirements: Implement verify_capsule(payload: Mapping[str, object], allowlist: CapsuleAllowlist) -> DecisionCapsule.
Implement propose_decision(source: DecisionCapsule, normalized_text: str, target: DecisionTarget) -> DecisionProposal.
Implement reconcile_proposal(proposal: DecisionProposal, portfolio: PortfolioProjection) -> tuple[Conflict, ...].
Normalize line endings and Unicode before hashing; canonical JSON uses sorted keys and one trailing LF.
Conflicting proposal creates an OPEN conflict and never overwrites source evidence.
validation: Repeated import of the same capsule is idempotent.
Changed normalized text with the old hash is rejected.
Proposal cannot alter SourceSnapshot, readiness, audit, acceptance, or merge facts.

steps.task: Add capsule import and proposal listing through the accepted loopback router seam without an approval endpoint.
requirements: Expose POST /v1/decision-proposals/import for a bounded capsule body and GET /v1/decision-proposals.
Implement the routes only in routers/decision_proposals.py for deterministic discovery by the accepted router loader; do not modify app.py, config.py, router_loader.py, or the host bind.
The import route writes only to a local non-authoritative proposal store with bounded retention and explicit delete-on-expiry behavior.
Route census must contain no approve, accept, commit, merge, activate, repository-write, or source-fetch endpoint.
Reject oversized bodies and scrub rejected content from logs.
validation: Tests prove proposal storage cannot call GitHub, Task Orchestrator, repository, or project-authority writers.
Tests prove the inherited service host remains exactly 127.0.0.1 and cannot be widened by this router or its configuration.
Raw transcript-shaped input and credentials are rejected and not logged.

steps.task: Render proposals and their disagreements through the foundation UI extension seam.
requirements: Show source kind, canonical locator, human approver, approval time, target, hash, manual-fallback marker, and import state.
Display competing repository evidence side by side with blocking materiality and named resolution authority.
Implement DecisionProposalExtension through the frozen extension contract; do not modify RepositoryPlannerPage, ConflictPanel, or the extension registry.
Provide no button or mutation path for approval, merge, acceptance, or repository commitment.
validation: Manual fallback and canonical capsule are visually and semantically distinguishable.
Keyboard and screen-reader tests cover proposal details and conflict comparison.

steps.task: Freeze the content head and complete one independent L3 privacy and authority audit.
requirements: Audit source allowlisting, approver binding, hash normalization, transcript minimization, log scrubbing, retention, conflict visibility, and absence of approval/write routes.
Do not claim direct ChatGPT-history retrieval; official OpenAI API Conversations are a separate API-created state surface.
Any head mismatch or non-passing verdict blocks readiness.
validation: Proof binds the exact audited head and contains no raw conversation text.
PR remains unmerged pending Control Tower disposition.
